# TechCrunch

> TechCrunch is the leading source for startup news, venture capital coverage, and technology industry reporting, with deep expertise in AI, space tech, and emerging innovations.

TechCrunch provides daily coverage of the technology and startup ecosystem, hosting major industry events like Disrupt and Founder Summit. The site combines breaking news, in-depth analysis, and exclusive interviews with founders, investors, and industry leaders.

## Key Topics

- AI and AI agents
- Startups and venture capital
- TechCrunch Disrupt
- Amazon and Alexa
- Blue Origin and space technology
- Cybersecurity
- Product launches
- Policy and regulation
- WordPress.com
- Humanoid robots
- Space data centers
- Tech news digest
- Startup Battlefield
- Jeff Bezos
- Trump administration tech policy

## News & Coverage

- [TechCrunch Homepage](https://techcrunch.com): TechCrunch homepage covering startup news, venture capital, AI, and tech industry
- [Latest News](https://techcrunch.com/latest): Daily news roundup and latest technology stories from TechCrunch
- [Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin enters the space data center game](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/20/jeff-bezos-blue-origin-enters-the-space-data-center-game): Blue Origin's Project Sunrise satellite constellation for orbital computing
- [Trump's AI framework targets state laws, shifts child safety burden to parents](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/20/trumps-ai-framework-targets-state-laws-shifts-child-safety-burden-to-parents): Trump administration AI framework prioritizing innovation over state regulation
- [Cyberattack on vehicle breathalyzer company leaves drivers stranded across the US](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/20/cyberattack-on-vehicle-breathalyzer-company-leaves-drivers-stranded-across-the-us): Intoxalock cyberattack impacts ignition interlock devices nationwide

## AI & Product Innovation

- [WordPress.com now lets AI agents write and publish posts, and more](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/20/wordpress-com-now-lets-ai-agents-write-and-publish-posts-and-more): WordPress.com AI agents for automated content writing and publishing
- [Amazon working on new smartphone with Alexa at its core, report says](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/20/amazon-working-on-new-smartphone-with-alexa-at-its-core-report-says): Amazon developing Alexa-focused smartphone codenamed Transformer
- [Employees had to restrain a dancing humanoid robot after it went wild at a California restaurant](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/19/restaurant-dancing-robot-went-wild-hot-pot-cupertino-haidilao-agibot): Humanoid robot malfunctions while dancing at Haidilao restaurant in Cupertino
